summary: First pass end-to-end testing of Astute Academy — 20/20 backend pytest tests passed and all critical frontend user flows verified (language toggle EN/MR, 6-step lead form submission, page navigation for USA/Germany/Medical/Counselling/About/Blog/Events/Contact, blog list->detail, events tabs, contact form submission, 404 fallback, admin login with invalid+valid credentials showing dashboard leads table).

issues: <title> is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' on every route — should be brand/route-specific (e.g. 'Astute Academy — Study in USA'). Impacts SEO and browser tabs.

action_items: Update index.html <title> and add react-helmet or per-page titles for SEO and brand consistency.
Consider adding hreflang meta / og:locale for /mr language variant (optional SEO enhancement).
critical_code_review_comments: Lead form validates phone as strict 10-digit numeric only (regex /^\d{10}$/) — country code / international numbers will be rejected. Currently OK for India-only target audience.
publicApi/adminApi error handling in LeadFormModal only shows a generic toast; consider surfacing server validation details.
server.py uses on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI (works but consider lifespan handler).
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded default when env var missing — acceptable for MVP but should be enforced in prod.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@astuteacademy.com / astute@2026 (from problem statement, verified working). /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present.
seed_data_creation: Data was already seeded (4 events, 4 blog, 5 testimonials, 8 faqs). Additional test data created: 2 leads (TEST_LeadUser, TEST_PW User), 2 contacts (TEST_Contact via API, TEST_ContactUI via UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both backend (pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, 20 tests) and full frontend UX pass cleanly against public URL. Seed is idempotent. Admin dashboard visible with leads/contacts tables. Only cosmetic issue: HTML <title> is generic 'Emergent | Fullstack App' on every route.
